description: This file contains functions and procedures for platform-specific firmware upgrade and identification for BCM4908 devices. It includes methods for identifying firmware formats, extracting content, managing upgrades via different formats, and handling upgrade states.

methods.name: get_content
methods.description: Reads specific content from a file at a given offset and length using dd.

methods.name: get_hex_u32_le
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a given offset and outputs as a little-endian hex string.

methods.name: get_hex_u32_be
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a given offset and outputs as a big-endian hex string.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Returns the expected firmware image name per device model.

methods.name: platform_identify
methods.description: Detects the firmware format and board ID from a given firmware image file.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_get_image_name
methods.description: Retrieves image name from a pkgtb firmware configuration.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_get_image
methods.description: Extracts image data from a pkgtb firmware file based on configuration.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_get_upgrade_index
methods.description: Determines the upgrade index for pkgtb firmware based on environment variable.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_commit
methods.description: Commits the upgrade state for pkgtb firmware, updating environment variables.

methods.name: platform_check_pkgtb
methods.description: Validates presence of expected images in a pkgtb firmware.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image against device expectations and format; performs integrity checks.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_clean_rootfs_data
methods.description: Cleans or verifies root filesystem data in UBI volume.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_pkgtb
methods.description: Performs upgrade process for pkgtb firmware, including volume management.

methods.name: platform_calc_new_cferam
methods.description: Calculates the next cferam (boot firmware) index for firmware upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_ubi
methods.description: Performs an UBI-based upgrade for firmware images, handling boot and root filesystem volumes.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main firmware upgrade entry point, detects format and calls appropriate upgrade routines.
